method: Read-only production PostgreSQL and existing signal-engine filter_audit endpoint; no production writes or email sends

nu_alert.qualification: EMA reconstruction substitutes the email price into the latest stored daily history; historical bars are not an immutable snapshot of data at send time. Rounded email values and direction reproduce.

news_filter_audit.qualification: Endpoint-reported retrospective cohorts, not independent classifier accuracy or causal on/off benefit. BUY-only selection, overlapping signals and no demonstrated date/symbol independence; five active observations are insufficient for a utility conclusion. Endpoint can label zero-sample rows predictive by treating a missing win rate as zero.
